chapters.title: The Boy from the Mountains
content: A young boy named Son Goku lives alone in the mountains.
He has a tail and possesses incredible strength.
Goku is kind-hearted but naive about the outside world.
He meets a teenage girl named Bulma one day.
Bulma is smart, adventurous, and searching for the Dragon Balls.
The Dragon Balls are seven magical orbs that summon a dragon.
The dragon can grant any wish to whoever collects all seven.
Bulma convinces Goku to join her on her journey.
Goku has one Dragon Ball that belonged to his grandfather.
He agrees to help Bulma find the other six Dragon Balls.
The two unlikely companions set off on their adventure.
Goku is fascinated by cars, airplanes, and modern technology.
He is also confused by many aspects of the outside world.
The journey to find the Dragon Balls has begun.

chapters.title: The Search Begins
content: Bulma and Goku travel to find the remaining Dragon Balls.
They encounter a talking turtle who seeks their help.
Goku and Bulma help the turtle return to the sea.
The turtle's master is the Turtle Hermit, Master Roshi.
Master Roshi is an old martial arts master.
He is also a pervert who loves beautiful women.
Master Roshi has a Dragon Ball as a reward for helping the turtle.
Bulma tries to get the Dragon Ball from Roshi.
Roshi agrees to give it in exchange for seeing Bulma's panties.
Goku convinces Bulma to go along with the plan.
Master Roshi gives them the Dragon Ball.
He also gives Goku a magical cloud called Nimbus.
Only the pure of heart can ride Nimbus.
Goku passes the test and gains a new friend.

chapters.title: The Emperor Pilaf
content: Goku and Bulma continue their search for the Dragon Balls.
They encounter a shape-shifting pig named Oolong.
Oolong tries to trick them but is defeated by Goku.
Oolong joins them on their journey.
They also meet Yamcha, a desert bandit, and his cat Puar.
Yamcha is afraid of women and cannot fight Bulma.
He joins their group after being defeated.
The group learns that Emperor Pilaf is also searching for the Dragon Balls.
Pilaf is an evil emperor who wants world domination.
He has already collected several Dragon Balls.
Goku and his friends must stop Pilaf.
Pilaf captures the group and takes their Dragon Balls.
He summons the dragon Shenron.
Pilaf's wish is interrupted by Goku's escape.

chapters.title: The First Tournament
content: Goku and his friends decide to enter the World Martial Arts Tournament.
The tournament is a test of strength and skill.
Goku wants to become the strongest fighter in the world.
His friend Krillin also enters the tournament.
Krillin is a fellow student of Master Roshi.
The tournament is filled with powerful fighters.
Goku fights against many strong opponents.
He uses his incredible speed and strength.
The final match is between Goku and Jackie Chun.
Jackie Chun is actually Master Roshi in disguise.
The battle is intense and spectacular.
Goku loses the match but learns a valuable lesson.
He realizes that he still has a lot to learn.
Goku vows to become even stronger.

chapters.title: The Red Ribbon Army
content: Goku begins his search for his grandfather's Dragon Ball.
The ball is now in the possession of the Red Ribbon Army.
The Red Ribbon Army is a powerful and evil organization.
They want the Dragon Balls for world domination.
Goku infiltrates the army's headquarters.
He fights against their best soldiers.
Goku defeats the army's leaders one by one.
He is joined by Android 8, a kind-hearted android.
Goku defeats the army's leader, Commander Red.
The Red Ribbon Army is destroyed.
Goku retrieves his grandfather's Dragon Ball.
He continues his journey to find the remaining balls.
Goku's strength continues to grow.
He is becoming a legendary warrior.

chapters.title: The Second Tournament
content: Years pass, and Goku has grown stronger.
He enters the World Martial Arts Tournament again.
Krillin and other friends also participate.
The tournament is more challenging than before.
Goku fights against powerful and mysterious fighters.
He is reunited with his old friend, Tien.
Tien is a powerful fighter from the Crane School.
Tien initially hates Goku and Krillin.
He is manipulated by his evil master.
Goku defeats Tien in the final match.
Tien is impressed by Goku's strength and honor.
He becomes a friend and ally.
Goku wins the tournament and becomes a champion.
His reputation as a fighter continues to grow.

chapters.title: The Demon King
content: A new threat emerges: the demon king Piccolo.
Piccolo is a powerful and evil being.
He was sealed away by Master Roshi's master.
Piccolo is freed and seeks revenge on the world.
He wants to conquer the Earth and destroy humanity.
Goku must face Piccolo to save the world.
The battle against Piccolo is the most difficult yet.
Piccolo is more powerful than any opponent before.
Goku uses all his skills and strength.
He is defeated by Piccolo in their first fight.
Goku trains with Kami to become stronger.
Kami is the Guardian of the Earth.
Goku learns new techniques from Kami.
He is ready to face Piccolo again.

chapters.title: The Final Battle
content: Goku faces Piccolo in the final battle.
The battle is epic and destructive.
Piccolo uses all his powers to kill Goku.
Goku fights back with everything he has.
The battle destroys the battlefield.
Goku is on the verge of defeat.
He remembers his friends and his training.
Goku finds the strength to continue.
He uses the Spirit Bomb technique.
The Spirit Bomb is powered by energy from all living things.
Goku defeats Piccolo with the Spirit Bomb.
Piccolo is destroyed, and the world is saved.
Goku is hailed as a hero.
His journey is far from over.

chapters.title: The Saiyan Saga
content: Goku learns that he is a Saiyan, an alien warrior race.
His real name is Kakarot.
He was sent to Earth as a baby to destroy it.
Goku's brother, Raditz, arrives on Earth.
Raditz is more powerful than anyone on Earth.
Goku and his friends fight against Raditz.
Goku sacrifices himself to defeat his brother.
He dies but is brought back to life by the Dragon Balls.
Two more Saiyans, Vegeta and Nappa, arrive on Earth.
They are even more powerful than Raditz.
Goku trains in the afterlife to become stronger.
He learns the powerful Kaioken technique.
Goku returns to Earth to fight the Saiyans.
The battle for Earth's survival begins.

chapters.title: The Battle Against Vegeta
content: Goku fights against the Saiyan prince, Vegeta.
Vegeta is proud, arrogant, and incredibly strong.
The battle is intense and destructive.
Goku uses the Kaioken and Spirit Bomb.
He fights with everything he has.
Vegeta transforms into a Great Ape.
Goku is severely injured in the fight.
His friends help him defeat Vegeta.
Vegeta is defeated but survives.
He escapes from Earth to recover.
Goku is hospitalized from his injuries.
The Earth is saved from the Saiyans.
Goku's reputation as a warrior grows.
He knows that more powerful enemies are coming.

chapters.title: The Namek Saga
content: Goku learns about the planet Namek.
The Namekians created the Dragon Balls.
Goku travels to Namek to find the Dragon Balls.
He wants to revive his friends who died in the Saiyan battle.
Frieza, a tyrant, is also on Namek.
Frieza wants the Dragon Balls for immortality.
Goku fights against Frieza's army.
He becomes more powerful with each battle.
Goku achieves the legendary Super Saiyan form.
The Super Saiyan form is incredibly powerful.
Goku fights against Frieza in a climactic battle.
He defeats Frieza and saves Namek.
Goku is now one of the most powerful beings in the universe.
His legend continues to grow.

chapters.title: The Cell Saga
content: Goku and his friends face a new threat: Cell.
Cell is an android created by the Red Ribbon Army.
He is the ultimate warrior, combining the DNA of the strongest fighters.
Cell seeks to absorb Android 17 and 18.
He wants to achieve his perfect form.
Goku and his friends fight to stop Cell.
Cell achieves his perfect form.
He announces a tournament to decide Earth's fate.
Goku fights Cell in an epic battle.
He sacrifices himself to save the Earth.
Goku's son, Gohan, defeats Cell.
Goku remains dead but continues to train.
He becomes even more powerful in the afterlife.
Goku's legacy as a hero is secured.

chapters.title: The Majin Buu Saga
content: A new evil appears: Majin Buu.
Majin Buu is a powerful and dangerous creature.
He was created by the wizard Bibidi.
Buu is childlike but incredibly destructive.
Goku is revived to fight against Buu.
He achieves the Super Saiyan 3 form.
The battle against Buu is intense.
Goku and his friends fight together.
They combine their powers to defeat Buu.
Buu is destroyed, and peace is restored.
Goku continues to protect the Earth.
He trains new warriors to follow in his footsteps.
Goku's adventures continue into the future.
His legend will last forever.
